description: A Django app that sends order status notifications by email, with SMS fallback, through Courier from a post_save signal.
rules: Use the trycourier package from PyPI and import it as from courier import Courier.
Read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment and keep it server-side.
Pass an idempotency key per status change to client.send.message, and reuse it on retries.
Send from transaction.on_commit only when Order.status actually changed.
Route email first, then SMS, with routing {"method": "single", "channels": ["email", "sms"]}.
